title: Canonical quotient-system isomorphism and pullback factorization
statement: Let f:X→Y be proper, Y locally Noetherian, F coherent, y∈Y and p≥0 [def-weil-proper-morphism,pqf-def-locnoeth,pqf-def-coherent]. Put A=O_y, X′=Spec A×_Y X, F′=g′*F, J=m_y O_(X′) and C=H^p(X′,-) restricted to A. There are an A-linear natural isomorphism b from C(F′/J^(n+1)F′) to the infinitesimal fibre cohomology system restricted from the completed local ring, and A-linear maps r_n:H^p(X′,F′)→H^p(X_n,F_n). For every n,z, r_n(z)=b_n C(q_n)(z) and r_n(z)=formalFunctionsFinitePullback(f,y,F,p,n)(z) [def-weil-pbc-formal-functions-finite-pullback]. This is the quotient-system/pullback part only, without a stalk comparison or Theta condition.

source.place: Tag 02OD, finite-level identifications; Tags 089W, 01F7 and 01FB (read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02OD, /089W and /01FB)

proof.text: For n≥0 put A=O_y and X_n=Spec(A/m^(n+1))×_Y X. Pasting the defining pullback squares constructs i′_n:X_n→X′ with g′ i′_n=i_n. The quotient-base-change closed-immersion theorem identifies its ideal with J^(n+1), where J=m O_(X′). It is affine. Composition of tensor pullbacks canonically identifies i′_n*F′ with F_n, which is quasi-coherent. The same universal property gives i′_(n+1) j_n=i′_n for adjacent levels. The map i′_n is the explicit pullback.lift of def-weil-pbc-formal-functions-finite-pullback. Its projection equation and pinned tensor-pullback adjunction define the h-map formalFunctionsFiniteFMap without arbitrary choices.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 02OD (lemma-formal-functions-stalk, lines 5759-5800)

proof.text: The closed-immersion unit u_n:F′→i′_(n*)F_n is epi with kernel J^(n+1)F′. Its induced quotient isomorphism rho_n:F′/J^(n+1)F′→i′_(n*)F_n satisfies rho_n q_n=u_n. Apply H^p and the affine cohomology edge isomorphism to define b_n. Cohomology h-map functoriality identifies b_n H^p(q_n) with pullback along i′_n. Restricting completed scalars along A→A-completion evaluates to Ideal.Quotient.mk on each level, so b_n is A-linear with the scalar actions in the Lean statement. Define r_n to be formalFunctionsFinitePullback with this A-linear structure; thus both required equalities hold. No IsFormalFunctionsTheta or stalk comparison is asserted.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 02OD (lemma-formal-functions-stalk, lines 5759-5800); Cohomology of Schemes Lemma 089W (lemma-relative-affine-cohomology) for the Leray step

proof.text: For adjacent levels, compare the two sheaf maps from F′/J^(n+2)F′ to i′_(n*)F_n. Precompose with the epimorphic quotient F′→F′/J^(n+2)F′. Both composites are u_n by compatibility of iterated tensor-pullback adjunction units and the defining transition h-map. Cancel the epi. Applying cohomology h-map functoriality proves that b_(n+1) and b_n commute with the adjacent transitions. Every arrow of ℕᵒᵖ is a composite of adjacent arrows, so the b_n assemble into the natural isomorphism b.

from.place: Canonical quotient-system isomorphism and pullback factorization in the finite-level portion of the formal-functions input to henselian idempotent lifting.

lean.statement: theorem formalFunctions_finite_quotient_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) (y : Y) (p : ℕ) : let X' := pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f let f' := pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f let F' := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F let J := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop ((maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv.hom)).comap f' let C := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X'.toRingedSpace p ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫ f'.appTop).hom ∃ b : formalCompletionSystem J F' ⋙ C ≅ formalFibreCohomologySystem f y F p ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y))), ∃ r : ∀ n : ℕ, formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p →ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y] formalFibreCohomologyLocal f y F p n, (∀ (n : ℕ) (z : formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p), r n z = (b.hom.app (op n)) ((C.map (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F')) z)) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p), r n z = formalFunctionsFinitePullback f y F p n z
